1. Smart Charging is available in the following two modes: 
a. Scheduled Charging: Set the start time and end time for charging, and connect the charger to charge at the specified time 
b. Scheduled Departure: Set the departure time, and connect the charger in advance. The vehicle will charge during hours with lower electricity rates as far as possible. At low temperatures, this function uses the charging station (or the power battery if no charging station is connected) to preheat the battery intelligently, so as to improve performance and range 
2. Currently, Smart Charging supports AC slow charging only, not DC fast charging 
3. When using a public charging station for slow charging, please check whether it supports Scheduled Charging/Departure 
4. The charging port as shown in the right figure on the scheduled charging interface is subject to the port position in the actual vehicle

At low temperatures, this function uses the charging station (or the power battery if no charging station is connected) to preheat the battery intelligently, so as to improve performance and range 
2. Currently, Smart Charging supports AC slow charging only, not DC fast charging

1. Smart Charging (including scheduled charging) is only developed for the AC slow charging devices distributed by BYD. Owners should turn off this function when using non-BYD certified AC slow charging devices (including but not limited to public AC charging stations, DC charging stations, and other charging devices purchased from third parties that are not certified by BYD). If the resultant response failure of these charging devices causes the inability to scheduled or immediate charging, which results in vehicle power loss and insufficient battery power, we will not assume any responsibility or compensate you for the resulting damage or loss

 2. Smart Charging (including scheduled charging) is designed to avoid the risks of power grid outage, charging facility failure and charging system failure by technical means. But we do not guarantee that you are free from schedule failure, failure to start charging as scheduled, or charging start failure due to aforementioned risks and other unknown risks (including uncontrollable risks). We will not assume any responsibility or compensate you for the resulting damage or loss

 3. Smart Charging (including scheduled charging) is set by applying the system time of the vehicle. It is normal that there appears scheduled charging or charging start time deviation due to the user's manual modification of the system time or the inability to calibrate the time due to network interruption. For scheduled charging on the mobile phone, if the deviation between system time of IVI and time on the phone is large, the APP will refuse to modify due to time abnormality. The above situation is the normal setting of the function, and we will not assume any responsibility or compensate you for the resulting damage or loss
